subject: Looking to make a dual range slider where the max and min are reactive

messages.author: 75f79ff907a797ec
messages.subject: Looking to make a dual range slider where the max and min are reactive
parts:
I am having trouble coming up with a way to make a dual slider where the min and the max range change based on the range of a data set that changes based on user input.

some sample server code

output$rstart <- reactiveUI(function(){
    rstart <- (databaseInput())
    r1<-sapply(rstart[[1]],max)
})

output$rend<- reactiveUI(function(){
    rstart <- (databaseInput())
    r2<-sapply(rstart[[1]],min)
})

databaseInput is a reactive function that grabs a data frame from an SQL query its headers are PeaksP1Time, PeaksP1, PeaksP2Time, PeaksP2


sample UI code
conditionalPanel(
        
              condition = "input.refine == true",
              sliderInput("sm","Range", value=c(input$r, input$2) , min =input$rstart , max =input$rend))


This obviously doesn't work. This is just how my brain thinks it should work.

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: Looking to make a dual range slider where the max and min are reactive
parts:
The issue is that ui.r is run once, when the shiny app starts. If you want to have the slider input min and max change to reflect other input values, you'll have to use dynamic UI (although this may change in the future).

For info on dynamic UI, see:
https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/D1GQlJeGD1k/kgmvmH2XS9cJ

-Winston
